book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.name: The White Ravens guide
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.tooltip: Everything worth knowing before you start.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.start.name: First steps
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.start.logow: The server runs in offline mode, because Microsoft sign-in in Raven Forge is still waiting on Mojang. A password guards your name instead.$(br2)First time:$(br)$(li)/auth register password password$(br2)Every time after:$(br)$(li)/auth login password
Until you log in you cannot move or break anything. That is not lag — it is what keeps your name yours.$(br2)Nobody can recover the password for you. If you lose it, ask staff on Discord.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.start.komen: $(li)/sethome name — set a home$(br)$(li)/home name — return to it$(br)$(li)/tpa nick — ask to teleport$(br)$(li)/tpaccept — accept$(br)$(li)/back — return where you were$(br)$(li)/rtp — a random spot in the wild
Your rank shows in front of your name. You can set a nickname with $(l)/nick$(/l) if your rank allows it.$(br2)Server chat is bridged to Discord — what you type in game is visible on the channel too.

The pack ships Simple Voice Chat. By default you talk to whoever is nearby — the further away, the quieter.$(br2)$(li)V — voice settings$(br)$(li)Caps Lock — push to talk$(br)$(li)M — mute$(br2)Rebind any of it in the controls menu.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.dzialki.cla: Open the mod's map with $(l)'$(/l) and claim the chunk you are standing in. Claimed ground is yours: no stranger places or breaks a block in it, opens a chest, or kills your animals.$(br2)How many chunks you may claim depends on your rank.
Claims are drawn on Xaero's minimap and world map — yours in green, other people's in their own colour. Nothing to switch on; the mods know each other.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.dzialki.for: Farms that run while you are away

A claimed chunk can be marked forceloaded — the server keeps it loaded even with nobody there. That is the only way a farm runs while you are offline.$(br2)There are no craftable chunk loaders here. The forceload budget comes with your rank, which keeps the server load predictable.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.dzialki.par: Create a party, invite your friends, then grant the party access to your claims. You build together and the rest of the server still cannot get in.$(br2)$(li)/openpac-parties create name$(br)$(li)/openpac-parties invite nick$(br)$(li)/opm message — party chat
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.dzialki.ran: A rank sets how much land and how many forceloaded chunks you may hold:$(br2)$(li)nowy — 3 claims$(br)$(li)osadnik — 8 claims, 1 forceload$(br)$(li)obywatel — 20 claims, 4 forceload$(br)$(li)rada — no limit, 8 forceload

Ranks are not sold for real money and never will be — Mojang forbids it, and it would make for a worse server anyway.$(br2)You move up by playing and by what you leave behind. A rank can also be paid for in game with staff; a person grants it, not a machine.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.handel.name: Trade and travel
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.handel.skle: Trading without waiting for each other

Craft a shop block from 4 planks, wool and an iron ingot. Put it on or beside a chest and set what you sell and for what.$(br2)There is no currency — you trade item for item. Diamonds are what people count in here.
Put the shop on your own claim. It sells out of the chest you point it at, so do not attach it to a chest you would mind emptying.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.handel.ways: Fast travel you have to find first

A waystone is a stone marker standing in the world. Click one to discover it, and from then on you can jump to it from any other.$(br2)You can place your own. On a claim it stays yours unless you share it.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.sprzet.name: Gear and comfort
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.sprzet.plec: Traveler's Backpack is worn on your back and shows on your character. You upgrade it in steps, it holds fluids, and with the sleeping bag out it sets your spawn.$(br2)On death it goes into your grave with everything else — nothing spills.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.sprzet.grob: Dying does not cost you your gear

When you die your gear does not lie on the ground — a grave appears. Come back and click it to take everything at once.$(br2)$(li)/grave list — your graves$(br)$(li)The grave is yours; no stranger opens it.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.sprzet.drze: A whole tree in one cut
Cut the bottom log and the whole tree comes down with it. Nothing to install or switch on — it runs on the server.$(br2)Hold sneak to chop the ordinary way, block by block.
book.ravenclassic.przewodnik.sprzet.shad: Turning them on and what to pick

The pack ships two shaders and Iris to run them. Switch them on in $(l)Options → Video → Shaders$(/l).$(br2)$(li)Reimagined — the default. Fine light and water, and the world still looks like Minecraft.$(br)$(li)Unbound — stronger, closer to realism. It costs more frames.

Drop the render distance first, shaders second. The rest of the tuning is in the pack and needs no setting up — Sodium, Lithium and a few more.$(br2)$(li)F3 — a readable debug screen$(br)$(li)C — zoom
